Project overview

A small off-plan villa project of six units in Thep Krasattri, Thalang, reported by a property portal as 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom villas of about 262 sqm. Very little verified detail is available.

The Manour: key facts

  • The Manour is a villa in Thalang, Phuket.
  • Units: 3 bedrooms, 262 sqm.
  • Construction status: completed; completion listed as Jan 2026.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Leasehold.
  • Nearest beach: Nai Yang Beach (5.8 km, straight line).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Nai Yang Beach (5.8 km, straight line); Thalang Hospital (6.7 km, straight line); Wattanapat Hospital Phuket (16.5 km, straight line); Big C (5.0 km, straight line).
